subject.title: fix(mac-gateway): write launchd stderr to a log file and surface it in diagnostics (#90711)

question: Should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/79892 own persistent macOS launchd log retention, and which restart and crash-relaunch modes must the permanent contract cover?
rationale: The current branch restores a shipped persistent sink but only partially bounds it, while the overlapping branch is conflicting and proposes different rotation, configuration, and lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Complete retention here
options.body: Accept persistent stderr and replace the partial cap with a lifecycle-complete retention design in this PR.

options.title: Revive the broader retention PR
options.body: Make the broader PR viable first, then remove duplicate retention policy from this branch and coordinate the two changes.

options.title: Keep stderr suppressed
options.body: Reject persistent stderr and design another supported capture path for early launch failures.

recommendation.title: Complete retention here
recommendation.body: Accept persistent stderr and replace the partial cap with a lifecycle-complete retention design in this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available history owner for launchd restart and recovery semantics.
